    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    Bat
    Represents the standard hostile Bat enemy within the dungeon grid.
    BossFloor
    Represents the special boss floor housing the Siren fight.
    ConsumableItem
    Represents a restorative item type that can be consumed by a player character.
    DestructibleTile
    Represents a tile within the dungeon layout that can be broken or collected.
    Dungeon
    Represents a multi-floor dungeon layout within the game world.
    EnemyChar
    Represents a hostile NPC entity within the dungeon grid.
    Floor
    Represents a single layer or floor layout within the dungeon.
    GameCharacter
    Represents an active character entity in the Mirror World of Numazu.
    GameGUI
    Serves as the main orchestrator for "Yohane The Parhelion! The Siren in the Mirror World!".
    GameMenuPanel
    View panel shown between dungeon runs, letting the player check their stats, choose a dungeon to enter, open their inventory, or return to the main menu.
    GamePanel
    View panel showing the active dungeon run: the tile map, the player's and enemies' positions, and live stats such as HP, gold, turn count, and item on hand.
    Initialize
    Handles the one-time setup and randomized generation of core game state.
    InventoryPanel
    View panel showing the player's held items and current stats.
    Item
    Represents the base blueprint for all inventory items within the game.
    MainFrame
    Top-level Swing window and entry point of the View layer.
    MainMenuPanel
    View panel for the game's main menu: lets the player start a new run, continue one in progress, or quit.
    NPChar
    Represents a non-playable character (NPC) in the game world.
    PassiveItem
    Represents passive equipment or upgrades purchased from Hanamaru's store.
    PlayableChar
    Represents a user-controlled character within the game.
    Shop
    Manages item offerings, dynamic menu rendering, and purchasing logic in Hanamaru's Store.
    ShopPanel
    View panel for Hanamaru's Store, letting the player browse unlocked and available shop items page by page and purchase them with gold.
    Siren
    Represents the Siren boss enemy encountered on the BossFloor.
    StatusPanel
    View panel showing the player's run statistics: how many times each rescuable NPC has been saved, total gold spent, number of game overs, and how many times the Siren has been defeated.
    Tile
    Represents a fundamental structural unit or coordinate node within the dungeon grid map.
    UITheme
    Shared color theme for the app's Swing panels: pink backgrounds, dark pink buttons, and purple text.
    UpgradeItem
    Represents a permanent stat upgrade item (e.g., Stewshine, Mikan Mochi, Kurosawa Matcha).
